name: collision
description: AABB + SAT collision detection, resolution, messaging; needs physics (a collider's body is a RigidBody/Velocity owner)
postInstallNotes:
## collision installed

Attach `BoxColliderComponent` (AABB) or `ConvexColliderComponent` (SAT) plus the `ColliderTagComponent` marker to entities you want to collide. Both collider types feed the same detection system polymorphically.

`physics` was installed alongside this module: collision resolves a collider's **body** through `RigidBodyComponent`/`VelocityComponent` (`ColliderBody.Resolve`), so the source does not compile without it. Registering `GravitySystem`/`VelocitySystem` in your pipeline stays your call — a trigger-only game can leave both out and still compile.

Pipeline:
1. `TransformCollisionDetectionSystem` queries `ColliderTagComponent` entities, computes overlaps, publishes `CollisionMessage` per pair.
2. `TransformCollisionResolutionSystem` applies trigger-style responses (no impulse — message-only).
3. `TransformPhysicalCollisionResolutionSystem` applies impulse separation — it acts only on bodies that actually carry `RigidBodyComponent` and `VelocityComponent`.

Subscribe to `CollisionMessage` in your game systems for trigger logic (pickups, doorways, dialogue zones).

**Premises:** `docs/premises.md`
